eval: var w=Main.World!; int n=0; while(w.Units.Count(u=>u.Role!=DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.UnitRole.Monster && u.State!=DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.UnitState.Dead && !u.LeftTown)<30){ w.Roster.Add("perf30_"+(n++), DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.UnitRole.FreePerson); } return "units="+w.Units.Count;
label: 平时负载：加人形单位到 30
